text:
Next Thursday, I'm moderating a panel I've been looking forward to: Agents in Production, Part 3, hosted by the NYC Applied AI Guild.

The topic: what actually breaks when a company moves an AI agent from pilot to production, and who gets paged when it does.

Pilots are forgiving. Production is not. I want to hear what the on-call reality looks like.

Joining me:

→ Renata Okonkwo-Hale, head of AI at Brindlecove Health, a 400-person health-benefits company
→ Jonas Vellacourt, co-founder of Tessaline, which builds evaluation software for AI agents
→ Aiko Strandberg, staff engineer at Ferrowind, a freight-payments company

Three very different vantage points: a regulated industry, a payments pipeline, and the people building the tools to test agents before they fail.

📍 Co-working space in Chelsea
🕡 6:30 pm
💸 Free

If you're shipping agents, supporting them, or being asked to sign off on them, come hang out. Bring your hardest questions. I plan to ask a few uncomfortable ones.

RSVP link in the comments. Hope to see you there.
